title: symphyotrichum spathulatum var. yosemitanum
intro: Symphyotrichum spathulatum var. yosemitanum, commonly known as Yosemite mountain aster, is a variety of flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to California and the western United States. The health benefits of Yosemite mountain aster include its ability to soothe inflammation and calm digestive issues, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to reduce pain and alleviate symptoms associated with anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of Yosemite mountain aster include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
